input.summary: On the solid-state game, clear white, yellow, purple, then red to raise Bonus X in stages. Build base bonus up top, collect it, then rebuild both values.

steps.text: Plunge for the far-left 5,000 lane. Avoid a plunge that misses every lane and falls down the left side.
Hit the single white target first for 2x. Then complete the two yellow targets for 3x.
modeNotes: Ordered Bonus X: Target position in the sequence matters. A later color does not raise the multiplier until every earlier color is complete.

steps.text: Complete the three purple targets for 4x. Then complete the four red targets for 5x.
Use the left orbit, center spinner, and lit upper-left star rollovers to build base bonus to 15,000.
modeNotes: Base bonus: Every five center-spinner turns add 1,000. Each lit green star rollover adds 1,000.

steps.text: Complete the last required drop target to collect the built bonus. Keep playing while it counts down.
modeNotes: Bonus collect: Completing all ten drops immediately scores base bonus times Bonus X. The maximum collect is 15,000 at 5x, or 75,000.
After the collect, base bonus and Bonus X reset. Rebuild both for another collect.

steps.text: Send the ball back to the top while the bonus counts. New scoring is kept during the count.

fallback.title: Up-top bonus
fallback.when: Use this when direct drop-target rebounds are worse than the orbit and spinner feeds.

steps.text: Repeat the safer left orbit or center spinner.
Build base bonus at the spinner and lit green stars.
Return to white-yellow-purple-red only when a target is safely presented.

alternatives.title: Purple extra ball
alternatives.when: Use this only when extra balls are enabled or converted to useful points.

steps.text: Complete the three purple targets.
Send the ball to the top and collect the now-lit purple lane.
Use the left orbit, every five center-spinner turns, and lit upper-left green star rollovers until base bonus reaches 15,000.
Complete white, yellow, purple, and red for 5x.
Collect 75,000. Then rebuild after both values reset.

techniques.name: Angled spinner entry
techniques.instruction: Guide a descending ball along a panel or through the far-right edge of the spinner gap. Avoid the straight left-side path.

cautions.issue: A ball descending the left-side rollovers can hit the lower post and deflect to the right outlane.
cautions.response: Watch the first plunge and upper return. Nudge before the ball reaches the post, based on this copy's rebound.

cautions.issue: A ball falling straight down the left side of the center spinner can drain through the middle.
cautions.response: Use an angled entry or the far-right edge of the gap. Be ready before any straight spinner exit.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm three- or five-ball play and carryover
Check Extra Ball and Special conversion plus any posts or gates
Use the first plunge to read top-lane and outlane feeds
